description_en: Creates a static username and password for open-source clients to access the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ server. Clients must pass authentication to access the server. ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ allows you to generate a username and password by using the AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 开源客户端访问云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版服务端时，需要传入用户名和密码进行权限认证，认证通过才允许访问服务端。云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版支持通过阿里云访问控制（RAM）的AccessKey和AccessKey Secret生成用户名和密码
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open create-account --instance-id 'amqp-cn-*********' --account-access-key yourAccessKeyID --user-name 'Mjo****************' --signature example-signature --create-timestamp 1671175303522 --secret-sign '4c1a6367ce4c4255e9617326f9133ac635******' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance for which you want to create a static username and password
parameters.help_zh: 消息队列RabbitMQ版实例的ID，表示您需要为哪个实例创建静态用户名密码
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey ID of your Alibaba Cloud account or Resource Access Management (RAM) user. For more information about how to obtain an AccessKey ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116401.html.

If you use the AccessKey ID of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user to create a static username and password for connecting to ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ and sending or receiving messages, make sure that the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is granted the permissions to send and receive messages. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146559.html
parameters.help_zh:
您的阿里云账号或RAM用户的AccessKey ID。获取方式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116401.html。

如果您使用RAM用户的AccessKey创建的静态用户名密码接入消息队列RabbitMQ版并收发消息，请确保该RAM用户已被授予收发消息权限。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146559.html
parameters.name: account_access_key

parameters.help_en:
The static username to be created.

The value of this parameter is obtained by constructing a string with the instance ID and AccessKey ID and then encoding the string in Base64. For more information about the calculation method, see the Sample code for calculating the username section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
待创建的静态用户名。

该参数值由实例ID和AccessKey ID构造的字符串经过Base64编码得出，具体计算方法，请参见本文中的用户名计算示例代码
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The signature. The system calculates the static user password based on the signature, the AccessKey secret signature, and the username in the request parameters.

The signature is calculated by using the HMAC-SHA1 encryption algorithm to encrypt the creation UNIX timestamp of the specified username and the AccessKey ID. For more information about the calculation method, see the Sample code for the signature algorithm section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
签名，系统将根据请求参数中的签名、AccessKey Secret签名和用户名计算出静态用户密码。

签名由指定的用户名创建时间戳和AccessKey ID进行HmacSHA1加密算法计算得出。具体计算方法，请参见本文中的签名算法示例代码
parameters.name: signature

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the username and password are created. Unit: milliseconds.

This timestamp is used to calculate the static user password and is custom-defined. It is not the timestamp when the system generates the username and password
parameters.help_zh:
指定该用户名密码创建的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

该时间戳用于计算静态用户密码，由您自定义设置。不是系统生成用户名密码时的时间戳
parameters.name: create_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey secret signature. The system calculates the static user password based on the signature, the AccessKey secret signature, and the username in the request parameters.

The AccessKey secret signature is calculated by using the HMAC-SHA1 encryption algorithm to encrypt the creation UNIX timestamp of the specified username and the AccessKey ID. For more information about the calculation method, see the Sample code for the signature algorithm section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
AccessKey Secret签名，系统将根据请求参数中的签名、AccessKey Secret签名和用户名计算出静态用户密码。

AccessKey Secret签名由指定的用户名创建时间戳和AccessKey ID进行HmacSHA1加密算法计算得出。具体计算方法，请参见本文中的签名算法示例代码
parameters.name: secret_sign

parameters.help_en: The remark for the static user
parameters.name: remark

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey ID used to create the username and password
AccessKey.description_zh: 创建该用户名密码所使用的AccessKey ID

CreateTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp when the username and password were created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimeStamp.description_zh: 创建用户名密码的时间戳。单位：毫秒

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance

MasterUId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account or Resource Access Management (RAM) user to which the AccessKey used to create the static username and password belongs
MasterUId.description_zh: 创建静态用户名密码的AccessKey所属的阿里云账号或RAM用户的账号ID

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
